niche_preference_profile: Prefers light, neutral interfaces with soft pastel purple/pink accents, clear structured hierarchy, organized card-based layouts, moderate visual density, and understated components. Favors labeled actions, small contained icons, integrated minimal loading states, and selective rather than saturated emphasis.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers light neutral backgrounds and soft gray surfaces over dark high-contrast themes.
Prefers interfaces with clear headings, labels, ordered content flow, and strong section separation over layouts where graphics or competing elements weaken hierarchy.
Prefers organized card-based or clearly aligned layouts with coherent form/list structure over oversized, weakly structured, or crowded compositions.
Prefers muted pastel purple/pink accents used selectively and consistently rather than intense, saturated, or mixed accent colors.
Prefers sparse but well-balanced layouts with comfortable margins and fewer competing sections, avoiding both crowding and awkward empty space.
Prefers subdued, integrated, low-shadow components and lower-emphasis controls rather than floating cards, heavy shadows, or highly emphatic buttons.
Prefers small contained symbolic elements and text-labeled actions that clarify meaning, rather than giant decorative icons or icon-only controls.

llm_analysis.why_user_chose_winner: They preferred a softer, more guided modal with clearer hierarchy and gentler visual emphasis.
